mode: web-e2e (Playwright Chromium + WebKit, fresh Vite, VITE_E2E_MODE) + visual/code audit + native simulator/build
scenarios_audited: keyboard-safe bug report, custom exercise and plate calculator
summary: The current product surface is substantially simpler and more coherent: one main Dashboard action, a single five-destination navigation contract, session-first History, clickable Profile stats without decorative badge rows, resilient onboarding recovery, three real palette presets and a test-first fix for rapid dialog close/reopen blackouts. Full Vitest, Chromium, WebKit, build, offline and native simulator/build gates pass. The remaining release blockers are physical-device lifecycle, accessibility scaling and native export/share verification; the main visible product debt is progressive disclosure of the large palette editor and splitting the crowded first onboarding step.

orange.title: The full palette editor dominates the upper Profile
orange.evidence: audit/shots/2026-08-27/active-user_profile.png shows presets, legacy swatches and custom hex before the settings list, consuming more than one viewport.
orange.suggestion: Keep a compact current-palette preview in Profile and reveal the full editor only after entering a collapsed Appearance section.

yellow.title: The first onboarding step still combines identity, palette and legal consent
yellow.evidence: audit/shots/2026-08-27/new-user_onboarding.png requires a long scroll before the primary action despite the one-task-per-step principle.
yellow.suggestion: Split personalization from legally required consent without changing legal copy, consent authority or persisted draft boundaries; verify abandonment and resume.

fixed_during_audit: Centralized Dzisiaj, Plan, Historia, Postępy and Ćwiczenia in MAIN_DESTINATIONS with full PL/EN labels and 44 px targets.
Reduced Dzisiaj to one dominant workout action plus two operational shortcuts; removed duplicate statistics and analytics links.
Made History session-first and moved cycles into a secondary collapsed disclosure without an overlay.
Implemented Pulse, Forge and Glacier PaletteThemeV2 with preview, cancel, confirmation, cold-start cache, cloud sync and legacy compatibility.
Persisted onboarding state per UID using official Capacitor Preferences; kept consent server-authoritative and retained the complete custom-plan draft until confirmed save.
Fixed the Radix blackout root cause: watchdog cleanup no longer mutates React-owned dialog content, closed content is declaratively non-interactive, and modal layers have an explicit stack.
Added mobile safe-area, keyboard, focus, Android Back and 44/48 target contracts to the main onboarding flow.
Added visible focus and target contracts to SettingRow, logout, calendar/week navigation and secondary Plan mode controls.
native_not_covered: physical interrupted-workout sequence and notification cold-start tap
physical native Share sheet and Files/FileProvider for JSON, CSV, PDF and PNG
physical HealthKit / Health Connect and haptics/sound
top_fixes: Complete physical iOS and Android background/resume, interrupted workout, export/share and restart recovery.
Complete physical VoiceOver/TalkBack and 100/150/200% text-scale QA.
Move the full palette editor behind progressive disclosure while keeping a compact current-palette preview.
Split the first onboarding step into personalization and legal consent without weakening server authority or recovery.
